mainEntity.name: Do I need experience to start?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The gym works for people at every level. Staff can help you get oriented.

mainEntity.name: What happens on a facility tour?

acceptedAnswer.text: You walk through the space, see the equipment, ask questions, and talk through which membership fits.
Power racks, barbells, bumper and iron plates, specialty bars, dumbbells, kettlebells, and conditioning equipment.
Staff can help during staffed hours. Structured personal training is a separate service.
151 Harvey West Blvd Ste D, Santa Cruz, CA 95060. Harvey West Business Park.
